info.name: LJVIS — ERRU NCR
info.description:
Functional tests for the ERRU NCR module, Stage 9-10 (LJVIS2-62/-63): outgoing request draft create/revise, case read (GET, full snapshot history), permission boundaries (ncr.read / ncr.create / ncr.respond), Pass/CleanCheck infringement-clearing rule, automatic received->viewed transition on first open, and the response-coverage validation (every requested penalty must be covered exactly once, isImposed=false strips penaltyTypeImposed).

The incoming fixture (business_case_id LV-NCR-2026-TEST0001, status=received, two requested penalties ids 1 and 2) is seeded directly via DSL/Liquibase/test/20260818100001-erru-ncr-inbound-fixture-seed.sql since Stage 11 (inbound endpoints) does not exist yet.
